SoundAlarmState.title: Sound Alarm State
SoundAlarmState.description: Represents the state of the sound alarm system for a user.

isArmed.description: Indicates if the alarm system is currently armed and listening for sound.

soundDetected.description: True if the sound sensor has detected a sound that crossed the threshold.

lastStatusUpdate.description: The timestamp of the last status update from the device.

alarmDuration.description: The duration in minutes for which the alarm should remain armed. Defaults to 0 (manual disarm).

definition.description: Singleton document for each user to hold the current state of their sound alarm.

params.name: userId
params.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the user.
